body.name: exact fitted-center experiment class
body.construction:
\(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{fit}}\) is the equal-arm stationary homogeneous marked-history class
\[
 \{(N,p,\gamma,T_N,K_{0,N},K_{1,N})_{N\geq N_0}:
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{rate\mbox{-}bounds}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{rate\mbox{-}membership}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{staffing\mbox{-}window}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{population\mbox{-}diverges}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{horizon\mbox{-}diverges}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{large\mbox{-}enough\mbox{-}system}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{control\mbox{-}stationary\mbox{-}start}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{treatment\mbox{-}stationary\mbox{-}start}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{arm\mbox{-}independence}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{control\mbox{-}dynamics}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{treatment\mbox{-}dynamics}}\wedge
 \mathrm A_{\mathrm{marked\mbox{-}history}}\}.
\]
In particular, membership imposes no upper restriction on the relative growth of \(T_N\) and \(N\).
